Sofia - Customer Success: Quick recap from the Q&A thread 11 Can we capture 1 sentence per deal on why we won/lost? we'll sort follow-ups.
Ravi - Product: Helio (win) 1 they picked us for predictable token pricing + streaming. They loved the TTL cache in console.
Liam - Sales: MercuryBank (lost) 1 RFP required HSM-backed key mgmt and detailed KYC of infra. We had Dedicated but didn't have the HSM cert path documented.
Aria - Eng: For MercuryBank the tech ask also included row-level encryption and audit hooks. We can deliver but need a scoped eng plan & security review.
Noah - Marketing: Helio win also noted in their blog 1 we should amplify that use-case (real-time chat ops).
Ethan - CEO: Good. Pattern so far: startups buy speed/cost, banks buy compliance + encryption. Prioritize a "Compliance gap" playbook.
Ravi - Product: Agreed. I'll draft a short playbook + a checklist for Sales to quote during RFPs. Need SMEs from CS, Sales, and Security.
Liam - Sales: Nominate Priya and Nate from AE team. Also request a short template we can drop into RFP attachments (1 page).
Sofia - Customer Success: I'm pulling a list of deals impacted and the exact asks. Will drop by EOD.
Aria - Eng: Technical action: implement an audit-trace shim and a small POC for HSM integration. ETA 2 weeks for POC.
Ravi - Product: Also: OrbitAI (won) 1 they loved our model rollouts feature and automatic fallbacks during peak. That was a clear differentiator.
Noah - Marketing: Let's capture OrbitAI as a case study candidate (permission pending).
Ethan - CEO: Any recurring product asks beyond compliance?
Sofia - Customer Success: Two big asks: 1) clearer Dedicated onboarding steps and a checklist; 2) better explainability logs for hallucination debugging.
Aria - Eng: On explainability logs, we can wire lightweight token-level scoring and a sample eval pipeline. I'll sketch a `debug_probe.py` snippet:
```
# debug_probe.py (sample)
def score_response(resp):
  tokens = resp.tokens
  token_conf = [model.score(t) for t in tokens]
  return token_conf
```
Ravi - Product: That snippet is perfect. We'll include it in the developer-facing docs.
Liam - Sales: BlueFin (lost) 1 they asked for SOC2 + on-prem availability. We have SOC2 in progress but timeline didn't align.
Sofia - Customer Success: From CS notes: wins = fast POC, transparent perf metrics, onboarding templates. Losses = missing certs, missing HSM/ROW encryption options, and limited on-prem cookbooks.
Noah - Marketing: I'll prepare a 1-pager "Why teams pick Redwood" targeted at platform engineers 1 bullets: unified runtime, predictable economics, rollout safety.
Ethan - CEO: Action items: Ravi = compliance playbook + Dedicated onboarding checklist; Aria = HSM POC + explainability probe; Sofia = customer list + outreach; Liam = RFP template request; Noah = marketing 1-pager. Can we aim for drafts by next Tue?
Ravi - Product: I'll create a doc and share link here: <https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/playbooks/compliance-gap-draft>
